test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: ​Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is "transaction."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **"Transaction"** is used to describe the exchange or trade between individuals.
 
• It means a piece of business that is done between people. ((लोगों के बीच) लेन-देन, सौदा)
 
• It conveys the idea that there is a formal or organized process involved in the swapping of goods or services. Using "transaction" adds a sense of structure and systematization to the process of people exchanging items.
 
• Hence, the answer is option 3.
 
• Correct paragraph:

In today's world, handling money and making purchases and sales come naturally to us. However, prior to the development of any kind of currency, people traded__ in a variety of ways. The barter trade was the simplest of them all. People would trade the things they owned for the things they wanted in this kind of __**transaction**__................

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Contraction: **the process of becoming or of making something become smaller or shorter. (संकुचन या संकोचन की प्रक्रिया; सिकुड़न, संक्षिप्‍तीकरण)
 
• **Agreement: **the state of agreeing with somebody/something. (किसी बात या व्‍यक्ति से सहमति)
 
• **Mutation: **a change in the basic (genetic) structure of a living or developing thing; an example of such a change. (किसी सजीव या विकासशील वस्‍तु की मूल आनुवंशिक संरचना में परिवर्तन, उत्‍परिवर्तन; उत्‍परिवर्तन का उदाहरण)
